ilana: quick note from a customer PoC: their tool returns an array as a JSON string (e.g. "[\"a\",\"b\"]") and after an auth-refresh retry the SDK hands the app a double-quoted value. app code does `res[0]` and blows up.

rafael: ouch. was this in jsonMode or structured-output?

ilana: jsonMode true for fncall/toolcall paths. interestingly, if the tool returns a raw array (not stringified) it works fine. only the stringified-tool case + retry breaks.

jo: this smells like the retry middleware treating tool output as opaque and re-encoding for transport. we had similar bugs when logging wrappers did `JSON.stringify(result)` unguarded.

ada: (typo) ada: can you paste the request/response flow? even psuedologs help.

ilana: pasted simplified trace from customer (sanitized):
```
CLIENT -> runtime: fncall user_lookup args={id: 7} auth=expired
RUNTIME -> tool: usersvc returns "[\"alice\",\"bob\"]" (string)
RUNTIME auth refresh -> retry
RUNTIME -> client: \"[\"alice\",\"bob\"]\" <-- double-quoted
CLIENT recv -> application treats as array -> error TypeError: res[0] is undefined
```

rafael: thanks. which SDK versions? node or python?

ilana: node 2.1.0 samplekit, python 1.8.2 sampleapp. node behaved slightly better because the helper attempted `tryParse` on top-level strings; python didn't. parity gap again.

jo: actionables I see:
- ensure SDK core normalizes tool outputs when `jsonMode` or content-type indicates JSON: return a parsed native value (array/object/primitive), not a quoted string
- make retry wrapper idempotent w.r.t structured outputs (detect already-serialized JSON strings and avoid re-stringifying)
- add a unit test simulating token expiry mid-call where tool returns a JSON string
- add e2e in samplekit CI that covers this case

ada: also update onboarding README: note that tools should return proper JSON typed bodies, and samplekits will be patched to be resilient to string-wrapped JSON until SDKs land fixes. small note saves hours.

rafael: will take SDK parity. i'll open two PRs: node patch (fast) + python follow-up. include a small helper `normalizeToolOutput(value, opts)` so both SDKs share the same logic and tests.

ilana: would prefer the helper live in shared spec docs first so implementations match. cc @devex for release cadence decision.

devbot: Created issue INF-4899: "SDK parity: fncall/toolcall retry double-wrap for stringified JSON outputs" assigned to @rafael. Priority: P2. https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-4899

jo: small mitigation for teams now: if you control the tool, return native JSON (content-type: application/json, not a quoted string). if you don't, add a defensive client-side helper:
```js
function safeParseMaybeString(val) {
  if (typeof val === 'string') {
    try { return JSON.parse(val); } catch { return val; }
  }
  return val;
}
```

nada: i'm adding this note to the samplekit README under "Known FNCall edgecases". will link INF-4899.

ilana: thanks all. ping me on the PRs if you want a repro trace (i'll attach the customer's minimal repro). :rocket:
